announcements.headline: EQS-News: Rational continues on growth trajectory and confirms profit forecast for 2026
announcements.insight: Rational confirms its profit forecast for 2026, reinforcing the organic growth trajectory noted in August. This guidance update supports shareholder confidence following recent operational successes.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Rational remains on track for success with organic growth of 8 percent in the first half of 2026
announcements.insight: Rational reports organic growth of 8 percent in the first half of 2026. This follows its fourth Best Managed Companies Award in May 2026.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: For the fourth time: RATIONAL won the Best Managed Companies Award
announcements.insight: This award highlights management quality but lacks financial specifics. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent operational or financial updates.
